results.message: What is the inactivity fee on the Get Conta, and when is it charged?
results.response:
Getnet's inactivity fee on the Get Conta is **R$10.00 per month**.

**When it applies:** Your Get Conta becomes inactive if it has no financial activity for **180 days**. The R$10.00 is then taken from your available balance every month until there's new activity on the account.

**What makes the account active again:** Any of these transactions:
- Receiving sales
- Sending or receiving money by Pix or TED
- Paying a boleto (bank payment slip)
- Making withdrawals
- Buying online or in a store with the Getnet Elo card

**If you've already been charged:** Make a new transaction on your Get Conta. That stops the fee from being charged going forward.

Source: Getnet's help page, "O que é tarifa de inatividade?" (https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-get-conta/o-que-e-tarifa-de-inatividade/)

A tarifa de inatividade é cobrada quando sua Get Conta permanece sem movimentações financeiras por 180 dias, sendo considerada conta inativa. Nesse caso, uma tarifa de R$10,00 é debitada mensalmente enquanto não houver novas transações na conta.
Como saber se minha conta está inativa?
Caso não realize transações na sua Get Conta no período de 180 dias, a cobrança é realizada sob o saldo disponível. Por outro lado, sua Get Conta se torna ativa ao realizar as seguintes transações:
Receber vendas
Receber ou enviar dinheiro via Pix ou TED
Pagamento de boleto
Realizar saques

- Receiving sales
- Sending or receiving money by Pix or TED
- Paying a boleto
- Making a withdrawal
- Buying online or in a store with the Getnet Elo card

results.response:
**On the card machine (same day only)**
You can only refund on the machine on the same day as the sale. Here are the steps:
1. On the machine's home screen, tap **Estorno**.
2. Enter the merchant password. By default it's 0000, but you can change it.
3. Type in the exact amount of the sale.
4. Tap or insert the card. It must be the same card that was used for the purchase.
5. Choose whether the sale was debit or credit.
6. Type in the CV code from the receipt. It isn't the card number. It's printed on both the customer's and the store's copy of the receipt.
7. Enter the date of the sale and wait while the machine processes the refund.

**After that day: use the Getnet Brasil app**
In the app, go to **Extrato** > **Histórico de Vendas** and filter by **Cartões**. Open the sale and tap **Cancelar Venda**. Choose a full (Total) or partial (Parcial) refund, then confirm with your location, your app password and an SMS code. The request is processed within 2 business days, and you can ask for a refund up to 90 days after the sale. You can also do it in the Portal Minha Conta: **Vendas** > **Cartão** > find the sale > **[+]** > **Cancelar venda**.

**Deadlines**
- On the machine: same day only.
- In the app: up to 90 days after the sale.

Getnet's pages don't give separate deadlines for debit and credit sales. To confirm a specific case, call Getnet support at 4002-4000.

results.message: What is Get Tap, and what phone do I need for it?
results.response:
Get Tap is Getnet's app that turns your smartphone into a card machine. You can accept contactless (tap) payments without renting or buying a separate device. There is no monthly fee, and you pay only for the sales you make. It accepts debit, credit (one payment or instalments) and digital wallets. Customers tap their card, phone or watch on the back of your phone, and you wait for the "venda aprovada" (sale approved) message. Sales are protected by Getnet's anti-fraud system, so they're as secure as on a regular card machine. Each sale can be up to R$200.00. Get Tap is available to individuals and MEIs (small sole traders) who meet the minimum security requirements.

**What phone you need:**
- **An Android phone running Android 11 or newer.** To check, open Settings, go to "Sobre o dispositivo" (About device) and look at "Versão do Android" (Android version).
- **NFC (contactless) support.** To check, search for "NFC" in your phone's Settings.

**How to start:** Sign up for free on Getnet's website. Then download the Getnet Brasil app from the Google Play Store and turn on Get Tap in the app.

Sources: [O que é o Get Tap](https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-get-tap/o-que-e-o-get-tap-e-como-funciona/) · [Como utilizar o Get Tap](https://site.getnet.com.br/get-ajuda-get-tap/como-utilizar-o-get-tap/)

results.message: Can I still charge my customers through WhatsApp Business payments?
results.response:
No, not through WhatsApp Business payments. You can still sell on WhatsApp, but now you charge customers by sending them a Getnet payment link.

- **Why it ended:** Meta, the company behind WhatsApp, decided to shut down payments through WhatsApp Business. The official end date was 15/01/2026, when WhatsApp Pay was discontinued.
- **What happened to your plan:** If you had a WhatsApp Business services package, Getnet switched it to a Payment Link package.
- **How the link works:** You can create it quickly in the Getnet Brasil app or the Getnet customer portal. Each link can accept one or more payment methods: debit, credit in one payment, credit in instalments, Pix or digital wallets. After you create it, you can send it by SMS, WhatsApp, email or any other way you talk to your customer.
- **Cost:** with the package that replaced your WhatsApp plan, you only pay when you use it: R$1.00 for each link your customer pays. Another Getnet page lists Payment Link at R$ 14.90/month. If you're not sure which price applies to you, call Getnet support at 4002-4000.

results.message: How do I end my partnership with Getnet?
results.response:
To end your partnership with Getnet, you need to **contact Getnet's Central de Relacionamento (Relationship Centre)**. Getnet's help pages don't describe a self-service way to cancel the partnership.

- **Phone:** 4002-4000 or 4003-4000 in state capitals and metropolitan areas. Everywhere else, call 0800-648-8000.
- **WhatsApp:** 11 97694-6815. This number is listed for cancelling Getnet products and services.
- **Hours:** Monday to Friday. The partnership cancellation page lists 8:00 to 20:00, but the product and service cancellation page lists 6:00 to 22:00. Calling between 8:00 and 20:00 is safest.

**If you also close your Get Conta (Getnet account):** you'll need to give details of another bank account so you keep receiving money from sales you've already made.

**Card machines:** you can ask for equipment to be picked up through the Getnet Brasil app or the Portal Minha Conta. However, the website doesn't say whether you must return the machines when you cancel, or how.

**Fees and pending obligations:** I couldn't find information on cancellation fees, fines or how outstanding obligations are handled. Please confirm these with the Central de Relacionamento when you call.

results.message: What fee does Getnet charge to settle my sales in Japanese yen?
results.response:
I couldn't find anything on Getnet's website about settling sales in Japanese yen or any other foreign currency, so I can't give you a fee for that. I searched twice with different wording and got no results on this topic. For a definite answer, please call Getnet support at **4002-4000**.

What Getnet does publish is in Brazilian reais:

- **Fees on each sale:** The fee simulators use values in R$, for example a Taxa 1,69% rate on the card machines page and Taxa 1,90% for Payment Link. Taxas sujeitas a alteração de acordo com as condições dos produtos e serviços contratados (fees can change depending on the products and services you have).
- **When you receive the money:** Todas as vendas feitas com crédito pré-pago tem recebimento em até 2 dias úteis e débito pré-pago em até 1 dia útil (prepaid credit sales are paid within 2 business days, prepaid debit within 1).
- **Where the money goes:** If you open a Get Conta, você terá número de Banco, Agência e Conta, o que lhe possibilitará fazer transações e receber suas liquidações das vendas realizadas (you get a bank account where your sales are paid out).
- **Getting paid early:** You can receive credit sales before their due date mediante uma taxa cobrada pela operadora ou instituição financeira (for a fee). The site doesn't give a set percentage for this fee.

You can only refund a sale on the machine on the **same day** it was made. No separate deadlines are given for credit and debit.

3. Enter the exact amount of the sale.
4. Tap or insert the customer's card. It must be the **same card** used for the purchase.
5. Choose debit or credit.
6. Enter the **CV code** from the sale receipt. This is not the card number. It's printed on both your copy and the customer's copy.
7. Check the date of the sale and enter it.
8. The machine processes the refund.

Enter every detail exactly as it appears to avoid errors.

If the same-day window has passed, you can still cancel the sale in the Getnet app. Go to **Extrato > Histórico de Vendas**, find the sale, and tap **"Cancelar Venda."** For questions about deadlines for older sales, call Getnet support at **4002-4000**.

results.message: My last credit sale was declined. Why, and how would I refund a sale on the machine if I ever needed to?
results.response:
Your most recent declined credit sale was **TX-90411**, today (2026-11-26), for **BRL 250.00** on terminal **GM-10377**.

**Why it was declined:** The card issuer declined it with **code 51: insufficient funds**, meaning the customer's card didn't have enough available credit. Your machine and account were not the cause. Your other recent sales went through normally, including a debit sale on the same terminal today. You can ask the customer to try another card or payment method, or to contact their bank.

**How to refund a sale on the machine:** You can only do this **on the same day as the sale**.
1. On the home screen, tap **Estorno** (refund).
2. Enter the merchant password. It is **0000** by default. If you've changed it, write the new one down.
3. Type the exact amount of the sale.
4. Tap or insert the same card used for the sale.
5. Choose **débito** (debit) or **crédito** (credit).
6. Enter the **CV** printed on the receipt. It appears on both the customer's and the store's copy and is not the card number.
7. Enter the date of the sale.
8. Wait for the machine to process it, and the refund is done.

Check every detail carefully, because wrong information can make the refund fail.

- **After the same day:** Cancel the sale in the **Getnet app** (Extrato → Histórico de Vendas → filter by Cartões → pick the sale → Cancelar Venda) or in the **Portal Minha Conta** (Vendas → Cartão → pick the date → [+] → "Cancelar venda"). This only works for card sales. To cancel a **voucher** sale, contact the card brand directly.
- **"Receba no mesmo dia" plan:** If you're on this same-day payout plan, you can't refund on the machine. You must cancel through the app or the Portal.
- **Credit vs. debit:** The only known difference is the choice you make in step 5. For details such as time limits or when the money reaches the customer, call Getnet support at **4002-4000**.

results.message: Was my R$ 42.90 debit sale today approved, and what is the difference between the statuses 'autorizada' and 'aprovada'?
results.response:
Yes, your R$ 42.90 debit sale today was **approved**.

- **Transaction:** TX-90398
- **Date:** 2026-11-26 (today)
- **Card machine:** GM-10377
- **Status:** approved, with no decline code or reason

Your account data doesn't show what time the sale was made. You don't need to do anything else for this sale.

**Difference between "autorizada" and "aprovada":**

- **Autorizada (authorized):** The sale has been requested but still has to go through the approval process.
- **Aprovada (approved):** The sale has been approved, confirming it is valid.

A sale shows as "autorizada" first and changes to "aprovada" once it passes approval. An authorized sale isn't guaranteed to be paid. If it isn't approved within the processing time, its status becomes "desfeita" (undone).

The help center doesn't say how long the processing time is or exactly when an approved sale is paid out to you. For those details, call Getnet support at 4002-4000.

results.message: Was my R$ 42.90 debit sale today approved, and what is the difference between the statuses 'autorizada' and 'aprovada'?
results.response:
Yes, your R$ 42.90 debit sale today was **approved**, so you don't need to do anything about it.

- **Transaction:** TX-90398
- **Date:** 2026-11-26 (today)
- **Amount:** R$ 42.90, debit
- **Card machine:** GM-10377
- **Status:** approved, with no decline code or other status details

Your account data shows only the date of the sale, not the time.

**The difference between "autorizada" and "aprovada":**

- **Autorizada (authorized):** The sale has been requested but still has to go through the approval process.
- **Aprovada (approved):** The sale has been approved, which confirms it is valid.

A sale normally starts as "autorizada" and becomes "aprovada" once approval is complete. If it isn't approved within the processing time, it becomes "desfeita" (undone) instead.

A sale can also end up as:

- **Negada (declined):** The card issuer or card brand did not authorize it.
- **Estornada (reversed):** You cancelled it yourself on the same day it was made.
